records.idot: IDOT Pay Item Report with Awarded Prices is an email subscription (webapps.dot.illinois.gov). It was not fetched. A third-party bid page was not used.
records.caltrans: Caltrans Contract Cost Data did not return an electrical-conduit weighted average in the pages read. Irrigation and drainage pipe items were not used.

method: Quantity-weighted mean of rank-1 unit prices on the official bid tabs. Not a TxDOT-published precomputed average. Rank 2 and later bids are excluded.
note: Item 618 is installed conduit, including excavation and backfill, per the TxDOT specification. It is not a bare material price and it is not escalated with the conduit PPI.
